Interpretation: Jack decides to visit a museum that is 150 miles away from home. He drives his car at 75 mph on the way there and back. He spends 6 hours at the museum. How much time will he be away from home? So total time away = travel time there + time at museum + travel time back. Travel distance each way: 150 miles. Speed: 75 mph. So travel time each way = distance / speed = 150 / 75 = 2 hours. So round trip travel time = 4 hours. Add 6 hours at museum = 10 hours. So answer: 10 hours. The instruction: "ANSWER: <one short sentence in Arabic>" So we need to write a short sentence in Arabic that states the answer. For example: "يستغرق 10 ساعات." Then FINAL: 10. The final line must be only the number. So we produce:
